C1242.title: Huabei and Baitiao Cash-Outs Become a Gray Market Chain with Commissions Up to 30%
C1242.summary: A 2015 investigation found that credit payment products like Ant Huabei and JD Baitiao were widely used for cash-outs. Intermediaries converted credit limits into cash through fake transactions, account theft, and fraudulent applications, charging commissions of 10% to 30%.
